ignore.reason: AssertSniff matches calls to Webmozart\Assert\Assert in the code it sniffs and names the class only through ::class, which never autoloads it.
The plugin runs inside Composer, which provides those classes itself; composer-plugin-api is the requirement, and composer/composer serves the analysis and the tests.
Composer provides symfony/console to a plugin at run time, as it provides its own classes; requiring it would install a copy beside the one Composer runs.

exclude.reason: The sniff fixtures hold the code the sniffs report; they are not code to style.

ignoreFiles.reason: The sniff fixtures hold the code the sniffs report; they are not code to analyse.

skip.reason: The sniff fixtures hold the code the sniffs report; they are not code to rewrite.
